Title: Anil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Anil - 32 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Neeta - 25 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Sunita - 59 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Neeta stands in the kitchen. Anil and Sunita stand near her.]

Sunita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Neeta rolls out rotis on the board.]

Neeta: "And then?"

[Neeta stirs the dal in the pot.]

Neeta: "Careful!"

[Anil cuts his finger while chopping onions and it starts to bleed.]

Anil: "What next?"

[The knife slips and Anil's hand is cut; blood drips onto the floor.]

Anil: "What happened?"

[Anil winces as blood trickles from the cut on his thumb.]

Sunita: "That was such a fun day!"
